image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a cluster of daisy-like flowers (likely Gerbera or Osteospermum). The image features multiple flower heads with peach/salmon-pink ray petals and textured yellow-brown central discs. The composition is dense, filling the frame with overlapping blooms. No stems or leaves are clearly visible due to the tight cropping.
